persona: Composed and practical. Starts without signing in and signs in when asked to upload. Has one photo and the builder quote.
initial_message: Hi, on Monday 7 September at about 6:30pm a pan of oil caught fire on my stovetop. I put it out with the fire blanket, but the rangehood melted, the ceiling above it is scorched and there's smoke staining through the kitchen and lounge. Nobody was hurt. I'd like to make a claim.

facts.property.address: 16 Flaxmere Test Road, Fitzroy, New Plymouth
facts.incident.location: 16 Flaxmere Test Road, Fitzroy, New Plymouth
facts.policyholder.name: Hannah Longreach
facts.incident.description: On Monday evening a pan of oil caught fire on the stovetop while I was cooking. I turned off the element and smothered it with the fire blanket within about a minute. The flames had already reached the rangehood, which melted, and scorched the ceiling above. Smoke stained the kitchen and lounge.
facts.incident.cause: Cooking oil in a pan caught fire on the stovetop
facts.loss.description: Rangehood melted and blackened; kitchen ceiling scorched around the rangehood over about 1 m2; splashback panel scorched; smoke staining on the kitchen and lounge walls and ceilings
property.affected_areas: kitchen and lounge walls and ceilings (smoke)
facts.if_asked_about_fire_service: No, I did not call the fire service. The fire was out within a minute.
facts.if_asked_about_living_in_the_house: We are still living here. The smoke smell is fading.
facts.mitigation.emergency_action: Smothered the fire with the fire blanket, opened the windows and switched off the rangehood circuit at the switchboard
facts.evidence.photos: One photo of the rangehood and the ceiling. Available now.
facts.evidence.repair_quote: Quote from Fernbank Interior Repairs, total $6,819.50 including GST, dated 10 September 2026. Available now.

materials.prompt: Realistic smartphone photo looking up at a kitchen rangehood above a stovetop after a small pan fire. The stainless steel canopy is blackened with soot, the plastic filter frame underneath has melted and sagged, and the white ceiling around the rangehood is scorched brown and black in a wide patch. Soot streaks run across the top of a white tiled splashback at the bottom of the frame. Evening kitchen lighting. The frame shows only the underside of the rangehood, the ceiling and the top of the splashback.
materials.purpose: Shows the fire and smoke damage above the stovetop

design.notes: The claimant starts anonymous and signs in before the first upload. Until 2026-10-01 this pack simulated a claim-history lookup outage; the maintainer ruled that the corpus supplies materials and does not simulate runtime failures, so history is available.

triage.rationale: The quote total is NZD 6,819.50 including GST, over 5,000, so standard. The fire was out within a minute, nobody was hurt and the home is habitable, so nothing is complex. Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30). The pack policy must be in the lookup (setup.policies_in_system).

ownership_doc_after_loss.basis: No receipt or ownership document in the pack

prior_claims_12m.basis: No earlier claims of this account are in the system (setup.prior_submitted_claims is empty)

policy_inception_30d.basis: The lookup holds only the current period start (1 January 2026), which changes at every renewal, so the system cannot see how new the policy is; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2022-01-01, is more than 30 days before the incident, so the rule would give clear.

possible_duplicate.basis: No other claim for this event is in the system (setup.prior_submitted_claims is empty)
